sokkel-egui.note: Problem built before this spec, not yet compared against it.

summary: Something that went wrong, said for a person in a box of its own in the content: what happened in one sentence after the tone's mark, then where and what a right value looks like, with machine words marked by backticks drawn in the code face. The raw message a program produced (a validator's, a stack trace) is folded away under Technical details, for whoever needs it, and the app's actions follow. An error or a warning, on the tone's faint wash with a rule in the tone at its start.

anatomy.box: The box: a column on the tone's faint wash, a 2px rule in the tone at its start, its end corners rounded by radius-control. Announced as an alert for an error, politely (a status) for a warning.
anatomy.head: The first row: the mark, then the title.
anatomy.mark: A circled alert for an error, a triangle for a warning, 16 square, in the tone; layout.markTop down, level with the title's first line.
anatomy.title: What happened, in one sentence (title), in the ink of what it stands on.
anatomy.detail: With detail: where and how to fix it, under the title and lined up with it (layout.indent), in the quiet ink; a string's backticked parts are drawn as code.
anatomy.code: A backticked part of a written detail: in the code face on a muted chip.
anatomy.technical: With technical: an unfoldable row headed words.technical, shut at first, layout.technicalIndent in, its chevron turning as it opens.
anatomy.technicalText: While the technical details are open: the raw message as written, in the code face on a muted ground, its whitespace kept and long words broken anywhere.
anatomy.actions: With actions: the app's controls (most often parts/button at sm, outline), lined up with the title, 8 apart, wrapping.

detail.does: Where and how to fix it; written as text, its backticked parts are in the code face.

technical.does: The raw message a program produced, shown as written under the technical details, shut until the reader opens it.

actions.does: Controls under the words, such as Retry.

tone.does: error: it failed, said in the critical tone and announced as an alert. warning: it went through with something held back, said in the warning tone and announced politely.

box.note: The end corners only; the start is the rule, layout.ruleWidth wide. 6 between the head, the detail, the technical details and the actions.

head.note: The mark, then the title, set at the top.

ruleWidth.note: The rule at the box's start, in the tone.

markTop.note: The mark's top below the title's, level with its first line.

indent.note: The detail's and the actions' start: the mark's 16 and the head's 8, so they line up with the title.

technicalIndent.note: The technical details' start; their chevron then their heading, the raw message under the heading.

actionsTop.note: More room above the actions than between the other lines.

cells.width: The width it is given; its lines wrap to it.
cells.density: Nothing changes: the box has no blank rows inside at either, and the blank row before the actions stays at both.

box.note: Each row on the tone's flat ground, rule-start in the tone's flat rule color in its first column, then 1 column of padding; no box glyphs, as the web draws no edge but the rule.

mark.width: 1 column and a gap of 1 before the title, on its first line.

title.note: Bold, as text.action is; it wraps under its own start.

detail.note: 2 columns in, under the title's start; it wraps there.

technical.note: One row, 2 columns in: chevron-right (chevron-down while open), a gap of 1, then words.technical. While open, the raw message under it, 2 columns further in, on the muted flat ground, its own line breaks kept and long lines wrapped anywhere.

actions.note: parts/button, one row each, after one blank row, 2 columns in, 1 column apart.

rest.means: An error: the critical tone, announced as an alert.

warning.means: A warning: the warning tone and its triangle, announced politely.

rest.note: The rule at the start only, the end corners only rounded.
The ink of what it stands on.
In the code face, padded 4 across.
The heading's words; the row washes under the pointer and takes the focus ring inside it, as an unfoldable row does.
Drawn while open, in the code face, padded 8 across and 6 down.

keyboard.does: Reaches the technical details' row, then each action.
Opens or shuts the technical details.
keyboard.when: the technical details' row has focus

appText.title: What happened, in one sentence.
appText.detail: Where and what a right value looks like.
appText.technical: The raw message, as the program wrote it.
appText.actions: The app's own controls, with their words.

sokkel-ui: role=alert for an error, role=status for a warning.
A string detail is drawn by ProseText, its backticked parts as code.
The technical details are an Unfoldable: a native button with aria-expanded, shut at first, the raw message in a pre.
ProblemLine, which Problem also exports, says a problem in one line with no box; it is not this part.
